title: psacalium cervinum
intro: Psacalium cervinum, commonly known as white sagebrush, is a plant species within the daisy family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in wound healing, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Psacalium cervinum include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
